title: Rational finite omega transition tower
statement: For the finite rational Verdier data F and E ≤ L ≤ M, the localized omega map from E to L transported by the L-to-M scalar functor and followed by the L-to-M omega map equals the canonical rational associator at E,L,M followed by the direct E-to-M omega map.

source.place: Localized form of the integral finite-extension u composition equation.

proof.text: Specialize IntegralFiniteExtension.comparison_composition to the three finite coefficient fields and the three ordinary duality presentations. Supply evaluation naturality at each field and take the u-composition conjunct.

Regard the u maps as arrows of the integral constructible full subcategories. The intrinsic integral scalar associator is their prescribed finite-extension composition map by integral_comp_normalization_bridge.

Apply rational localization to this integral triangle. The pure-tensor map normalization with scalar one identifies extension of a localized arrow with localization of its integral extension. The prescribed rational associator is the localized integral associator. Transport compositions with heq_comp using the explicit scalar object equations, and substitute the three omega normalizations from F.normalized.

Use coefficientInclusion_laws to identify the composite embedding with the direct embedding. The uniqueness specification of the chosen finite-stage associator identifies it with scalarAssociator, giving the stated tower equation.

proof_origin.place: Finite integral-to-rational coefficient passage; localized finite-extension u-composition equation, group Z6.

from.place: Decomposition of the finite omega tower proof.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteOmegaTransition_tower (F : Finite D l hl Ω X)
    {E L M : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (k : L ≤ M) :
    (sfRationalScalarExtension l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) X 0
      (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) (Coefficient.{u} l Ω M)
      (coefficientInclusion l Ω L M k)).map ((F.scalar E L h).omega.hom) ≫
        (F.scalar L M k).omega.hom =
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.associator l Ω X E L M h k).hom.app
          ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) X).obj
            (F.omega E).omega) ≫
        (F.scalar E M (h.trans k)).omega.hom
